{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.92

|gr1= Map and Markers

|eff= global

|descr= Converts serialized data from [[BIS_fnc_markerToString]] into a global map marker

|s1= data call [[BIS_fnc_stringToMarker]]

|p1= data: [[String]] - serialized data

|r1= [[String]] - created global marker

|x1= <sqf>"|marker_0|[3799.0110,2781.9880,0.0000]|mil_pickup|ICON|[1,1]|0|Solid|Default|1|You are here" call BIS_fnc_stringToMarker;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_markerToString]] [[BIS_fnc_stringToMarkerLocal]] [[BIS_fnc_triggerToMarker]] [[createMarker]] [[createMarkerLocal]]
}}

{{Note
|user= 7erra
|timestamp= 20190503121600
|text= The format is the following:
<code style="display: block">"<nowiki>|</nowiki>MARKERNAME<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerPos]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerType]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerShape]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerSize]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerDir]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerBrush]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerColor]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerAlpha]]<nowiki>|</nowiki>[[markerText]]"</code>
The delimiter for [[BIS_fnc_stringToMarker]] is the first character of the string.
}}
